Paul —

Thanks for sending over the W9 and intake form. Quick answers below and a couple of action items so we can move to payment activation: 

1) PO requirement: For standard vendor categories we require a PO for any invoice > $2,500. Smaller invoices can be processed without a PO but should include your invoice number and remit string. If you'd like all invoices to map to POs automatically, we can set up a default PO prefix.

2) Remittance format: Our accounting system ingests CSV/XML remittance where the invoice number maps to invoice_reference and PO maps to po_reference. Recommended remittance string to appear on invoices: RiveEdge Inc. — INV:{invoice_number} — PO:{po_number} (if available).

3) Banking: We support ACH (preferred) and wire. For wires we require beneficiary name + bank routing + account and an ACH transfer test (micro-deposit) for ACH verification.

I attached the PO_Mapping_Template.csv — fill columns A:C with your internal PO label, desired PO prefix, and any special invoice tags. Also included is a short Vendor_Onboard_Checklist (page 2 of the attached) so our FinOps team can finish verification.

Next steps I propose:
- Paul: complete PO_Mapping_Template.csv and reply with bank proof (voided check or bank letter) — target EOD Fri.
- Priyom: can you run the onboarding checklist and flag any missing items?
- Marissa: once bank proof is in, can you kick off the ACH micro-deposit test and confirm remittance mapping in the sandbox?

I'll mark this thread as procurement onboarding and move into our vendor queue once we have the bank proof.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
